title: Tenant identity and confused-deputy boundary matrix

boundaries.name: Meta WhatsApp webhook signature / hub verify
boundaries.source_identity: X-Hub-Signature-256 (when META_APP_SECRET set); hub.verify_token for GET
boundaries.trusted_principal: Meta app secret / verify token from env
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Invalid verify token → 403. Missing app secret → signature verification skipped (skipped:true). Signature mismatch → verified:false.
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Signature skip when META_APP_SECRET absent is documented; production presence of secret not proven by offline tests. Fail-closed policy → unproven, not safe.
boundaries.blast_radius: spoofed inbound WhatsApp events if secret unset

boundaries.name: Meta normalize live client_slug vs tenant_channel_shadow
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Shadow may resolve sunset while live normalized.client_slug stays wolfhouse-somo. Unknown phone_number_id sets channel_resolution_blocked in shadow only; live path not rejected.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: guest_message_events.normalized may store both live slug and tenant_channel_shadow
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: Wrong live tenant can draft/handle guest under wolfhouse default
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Code + docs prove shadow does not override live client_slug; hard blocking not enabled. Conflicting phone_number_id → wrong live tenant default.
boundaries.blast_radius: cross-tenant guest handling on shared Meta ingress / shared Staff API

boundaries.name: Channel resolver phone_number_id → client_slug+location_id
boundaries.source_identity: phone_number_id or email_to from routing map
boundaries.trusted_principal: config/clients/clients.json + channel routing map (sample or CLIENT_CHANNEL_ROUTING_*)
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Unknown identity → blocked unknown_channel_identity; never Wolfhouse fallback. Duplicate phone_number_id in map throws at build time. Location must belong to client in registry.
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Resolver library and offline verifiers prove unknown IDs blocked and registry ownership enforced.

boundaries.name: Hermes Wolfhouse fixed LUNA_CLIENT_SLUG runtime context
untrusted_tenant_fields: tool args client_slug if any handler trusts body downstream
boundaries.conflict_behavior: pause_gate / mirror skip when LUNA_CLIENT_SLUG missing (fail closed). Mirror never invents wolfhouse default.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: Staff API calls carry runtime client_slug in payload
boundaries.payment_secret_account_binding: Staff API base URL from env (WOLFHOUSE_STAFF_API_BASE_URL)
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: Runtime-isolated if separate Hermes + token + Staff API; unproven if shared bot token accepts foreign slug
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Hermes side binds tenant from env and fails closed when missing. Cross-tenant still depends on Staff API bot binding (B06/B07).

boundaries.name: Sunset Hermes phone_number_id → Somo vs Sardinero
boundaries.source_identity: Meta phone_number_id matched to SUNSET_*_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID env
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Unknown or duplicate phone_number_id throws (fail closed). Mirror refuses inventing sunset-sardinero from Somo runtime.
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: Sardinero vs Somo confusion rejected when IDs unique
boundaries.verdict_rationale: JS + Python routers throw on unknown phone_number_id; duplicate env IDs rejected.
boundaries.blast_radius: wrong Sunset school location if misconfigured env (ops), not guest-forgeable

boundaries.name: Staff API requireBotAuth principal
boundaries.chain: Staff API bot auth and request parsing
boundaries.source_identity: X-Luna-Bot-Token / Bearer vs LUNA_BOT_INTERNAL_TOKEN; else session cookie
boundaries.trusted_principal: Shared bot token → synthetic user {role:operator, staff_user_id:luna-bot-internal} with NO client_id/email
untrusted_tenant_fields: any client_slug in body/query/path after auth
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Wrong token → 401 (no session fallthrough). Empty token disables bot path. Open mode when STAFF_AUTH_REQUIRED=false.
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: Principal is cross-tenant capable; isolation deferred to handlers
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Bot token principal has no tenant binding. getAccessibleClientSlugs returns ALL clients when user.email missing — so assertStaffClientAccess cannot constrain bot user.
boundaries.blast_radius: all tenants reachable by any holder of the shared bot token on that Staff API

boundaries.name: Staff API bot handlers body/query client_slug trust
boundaries.chain: Staff API bot auth and request parsing
boundaries.trusted_principal: Intended: runtime DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG. Actual: many handlers treat body as trustedClientSlug.
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Sunset /staff/bot/sunset/* FORCE client_slug=sunset (body ignored). Generic /staff/bot/* trust body. Wolfhouse booking-create rejects trustedClientSlug≠wolfhouse-somo but still sources trustedClientSlug from body.
boundaries.payment_secret_account_binding: payment link builders may inherit body-chosen trustedClientSlug
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: foreign client_slug accepted on trust_body handlers
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Evidence proves asymmetric policy: Sunset forced, generic bot paths trust body. DEFAULT_CLIENT hardcoded ignoring DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG for most handlers.
boundaries.blast_radius: booking/read/write under wrong tenant when bot token + shared Staff API

boundaries.name: Portal/staff session assertStaffClientAccess
boundaries.trusted_principal: Session cookie hash → DB session row
boundaries.conflict_behavior: assertStaffClientAccess → 403 client_access_denied when auth required and user cannot access slug. Login binds client from body.client joined to DB.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: handlers that call assertStaffClientAccess before SQL
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: denied when assert called; unproven on handlers that skip assert
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Session endpoint scopes clients to login company; assertStaffClientAccess used on many staff routes. Caveat: coverage of every route is registry-based (B10).
boundaries.blast_radius: staff portal data for allowed clients only when assert present

boundaries.name: Portal deploy host / DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG vs session mismatch
boundaries.source_identity: DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG env, else allowlisted staging host map, else wolfhouse-somo
boundaries.trusted_principal: Deployment env beats Host; Host only for exact allowlisted staging hostnames
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Spoofed Host ignored when DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG set. Session clients limited to active login client.
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: UI may show wrong default if localStorage stale — API must still assert
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Offline tests prove DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG beats Host spoofing; session scoped to login client.
boundaries.blast_radius: portal UX confusion; API gated by session

boundaries.name: DB client_slug / client_id / location_id SQL predicates
boundaries.source_identity: Resolved client_id/slug from auth or forced tenant
untrusted_tenant_fields: raw object UUIDs without client predicate
boundaries.conflict_behavior: staff-tenant-scope scanner + debt registry classifies hotspots; unclassified debt fails verifier
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: AND client_id / JOIN clients.slug / client_slug = $n (varies by query)
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: object UUID alone is insufficient when scope present; residual debt tracked in registry
boundaries.verdict_rationale: verify:staff-tenant-scope + multiclient gates prove scoped payment-link SQL and classified debt registry. Residual grandfathered debt is explicit, not silent.
boundaries.blast_radius: depends on unclassified debt — currently gated

boundaries.name: Stripe checkout / payment-link creation account+metadata
boundaries.trusted_principal: assertTrustedTenant(command); Stripe secret from env (one per Staff API runtime)
boundaries.conflict_behavior: client_slug override rejected vs trustedClientSlug. Live keys blocked for staging. Money fields rejected.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: payment row insert with client_id; updates WHERE id AND client_id
boundaries.payment_secret_account_binding: single STRIPE_SECRET_KEY per runtime — isolation by separate Staff API deploy
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Code rejects body override vs trustedClientSlug and scopes SQL by client_id. Account isolation is one secret per runtime (architecture), not multi-account routing in-process.
boundaries.blast_radius: wrong-tenant link if caller passes wrong trustedClientSlug (see B07)

boundaries.name: Stripe webhook signature verification
boundaries.trusted_principal: Stripe webhook signing secret for this runtime
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Missing secret → 503. Bad signature → 400. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SKIP_VERIFY bypasses (dev only).
boundaries.payment_secret_account_binding: one webhook secret per Staff API; mixed secrets across tenants not supported in-process
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: signature does not select tenant — only admits events for this Stripe account
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Fail-closed without secret; signature verified when configured. Tenant isolation relies on per-client Stripe account + runtime (architecture). Skip-verify is a footgun if enabled.
boundaries.blast_radius: forged payment truth if skip-verify or secret leak

boundaries.name: Stripe webhook payment lookup by session id / metadata.payment_id
boundaries.chain: Stripe webhook signature/tenant resolution → booking/hold/payment lookup
boundaries.source_identity: session.id first; else metadata.payment_id UUID global lookup
boundaries.trusted_principal: Intended: stripe_checkout_session_id row. Fallback: metadata.payment_id without client predicate in WHERE.
boundaries.conflict_behavior: validateStripeBookingPaymentEvent rejects client_slug mismatch ONLY if metadata.client_slug present. Missing client_slug on metadata-only path does not fail closed.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: WHERE p.stripe_checkout_session_id=$1 OR WHERE p.id=$1::uuid (no client_id in lookup SQL)
boundaries.payment_secret_account_binding: webhook secret gates admission; lookup is global within DB
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: valid payment UUID from another tenant can be selected on shared DB when session id miss + metadata.payment_id set
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Code-grounded: metadata.payment_id fallback is a global UUID SELECT without client_id. client_slug check is optional. Highest money blast radius on shared DB+Stripe staging.
boundaries.blast_radius: mark another tenant payment paid / promote hold on shared DB

boundaries.name: Stripe payment-truth locked identity revalidation
boundaries.source_identity: Locked payment row client_id + session.id / metadata.payment_id binding
boundaries.trusted_principal: DB lock for payment_id+client_id and booking_id+client_id
boundaries.conflict_behavior: CLIENT_MISMATCH / BOOKING_MISMATCH / METADATA_PAYMENT_ID_MISMATCH / BINDING_MISSING fail closed at apply time — but only after lookup already selected the row.
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: revalidation cannot fix wrong initial lookup if expectedClientId comes from that same row
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Locked revalidation is strong for session/metadata consistency on the selected row, but expectedClientId is derived from the lookup result — does not independently re-resolve tenant. Absence of cross-tenant expectedClientId proof → unproven.

boundaries.name: Booking / hold / payment object lookup callbacks
boundaries.conflict_behavior: Many staff routes assert client access then JOIN clients.slug. Bot routes may trust body slug (B07). Short-link redirect uses query.client || DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG || wolfhouse-somo.
boundaries.db_scope_predicate: varies; payment short link includes client_slug
boundaries.cross_tenant_object_id_behavior: duplicate global booking_codes across tenants would be ambiguous — uniqueness not proven here
boundaries.verdict_rationale: Mixed evidence: some lookups join client slug, others depend on caller. Global booking_code uniqueness across tenants not proven in this audit.
boundaries.blast_radius: cross-tenant booking/payment read or mutate if unscoped UUID path exists

findings_ranked.title: Stripe webhook metadata.payment_id global UUID lookup without mandatory tenant predicate
Bot token principal has no tenant binding; email-less user passes all client ACL
Generic /staff/bot/* trusts body.client_slug; DEFAULT_CLIENT hardcoded wolfhouse-somo
Meta live client_slug ignores shadow resolution; unknown phone_number_id not hard-blocked
Locked payment identity revalidation cannot independently re-bind tenant after poisoned lookup
Meta signature verification skippable when META_APP_SECRET absent (unproven in prod)
Booking/payment callback scoping inconsistent; global ID uniqueness unproven
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SKIP_VERIFY bypass footgun; single secret per runtime

slice_15b_selection.rationale: Highest severity (critical money path), directly evidenced in code, smallest ownership surface (one lib + webhook caller validations), and regression-testable offline without live Stripe.
acceptance_tests: RED: metadata-only lookup with payment_id belonging to other tenant client_slug must not select/apply
RED: metadata-only lookup missing metadata.client_slug must fail closed
RED: metadata.client_slug mismatch vs payment.client_slug must fail closed
GREEN: session.id authoritative match still applies when metadata.client_slug absent
GREEN: metadata-only path with matching payment_id + client_slug still allowed only within same tenant predicate
slice_15b_selection.out_of_scope_for_15a: Do not implement behavior fix in 15A — selection only.
